renMemoryRecords.text: Ren, these carp are perfect! I'll grill one with pondside herbs tonight. If you catch more, I'd gladly buy another at the same price.
Glad they suit you, Sora. The pond's been generous today. I'll bring more carp to the same spot if the water keeps giving.
Then it's settled, Ren. Same spot, same price for the next carp. I'll bring the herbs and we'll make a proper pondside feast.
A proper feast it is, Sora. Pond's quiet and the light's good, so I'll keep at it. See you same spot with the next carp.
